headline: Software Developer & System Engineer
summary: Software Developer crafting thoughtful digital experiences, building scalable web applications, and exploring the intersection of software engineering, intelligent systems, and technology.
statement: My foundation is in electronics, but my curiosity lies at the intersection of software, systems, and engineering. I'm drawn to the details that make software dependable — the invariants, the edge cases, and the logic that holds everything together. From developer tools and real-time systems to algorithm visualizers, I build things to understand how they work, not just how they look. I value precision over complexity, working systems over impressive claims, and thoughtful execution over unnecessary scale.
